steps.title: Install Steam on this computer
steps.explanation: Install the official Steam client if it is not already present on Windows.
steps.expectedResult: Steam is installed and can open on Windows.
steps.verification: Check local software presence for component `steam`.
steps.onFailure: Open the official Steam installer page from VUA and complete the Windows installation.

steps.title: Sign in to Steam
steps.explanation: Sign in with your own Steam account inside the official Steam window. VUA never receives your password.
steps.verification: Confirm the Steam client main library window is signed in and online.
steps.onFailure: Complete Steam Guard verification or password recovery in the official Steam client.

steps.title: Install VRChat in Steam
steps.explanation: Ensure VRChat is installed in your Steam library before starting play.
steps.expectedResult: VRChat is installed and ready in Steam.
steps.verification: Check local software presence for component `vrchat`.
steps.onFailure: Open VRChat in Steam and finish downloading any pending update.

steps.title: Launch VRChat in desktop mode
steps.explanation: Start VRChat on your computer screen without a headset.
steps.verification: Observe the running play session or external tool process state in VUA.
steps.onFailure: Recheck the preceding connection and Steam steps before requesting launch again.

lastVerification.environment: Windows 11 play-route flow and official upstream documentation
